function: Excluded for function: the learned transformer performs human activity recognition from Wi-Fi CSI under continual learning (p. 2, p. 10), a sensing task outside the seven areas.
notes: Reason function: the method classifies 10 user activities from uplink CSI (p. 2 'discriminative sensing tasks', p. 10 HAR dataset) and designs no beams, waveforms, or resources, so it is not area 5. The PDF is the arXiv v2 preprint (2502.12736v2, 14 Apr 2025) titled Cross-Domain Continual Learning for Edge Intelligence in Wireless ISAC Networks; the DOI is not printed in the file, so identity rests on the title.
